hooks.line: Your LED bulb is secretly blue.
This color took around thirty years to make.
Why did blue light take thirty years?

notes: The assembler centres speech in each 10 s block, so block 1 needs a take of about 9.2-9.4 s (about 24-28 words, fast delivery, 00:07-00:09 bracket) for the first sentence to finish by about 2.6 s.
